title: Minimum degree at most five under the planar edge bound
statement: Let $G$ be a simple graph on a finite vertex set with $n \ge 3$ vertices, and write $E$ for its number of edges. If $E + 6 \le 3n$ — equivalently $E \le 3n - 6$ — then $G$ has a vertex of degree at most $5$; that is, the minimum degree of $G$ satisfies $\delta(G) \le 5$.
